bio.text: Patty Contreras is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 12, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Contreras is a third-generation Arizonan originally from the Yuma valley who has lived in Ahwatukee since 1991 and holds a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University and a master's degree from Northern Arizona University.
The profile says Contreras worked more than 30 years for the City of Phoenix in the Parks and Recreation and Human Services departments, overseeing eight of the city's 15 senior centers.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 12 (candidate-submitted statements)
